game_concept: A logic puzzle set in Mt. Pyre – Basalt Stair, a basalt column stairway: the forge smith must handle magma slimes while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Comparison Duel: Choose ==, !=, < , > or >= so the forge smith's power beats the shield shown by magma slimes.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Basalt Stair: a basalt column stairway
core_gameplay_loop: In Basalt Stair, repeat each round: Choose ==, !=, < , > or >= so the forge smith's power beats the shield shown by magma slimes. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the power value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the ash barrier using at most 18 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: The ash barrier reached with actions_used <= 18.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 18 before the ash barrier is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 1 (intro tier): Comparison Duel
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how power changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against magma slimes in Basalt Stair.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The ash barrier reached with actions_used <= 18.
